name: Yangzijiang Financial Holding Ltd.
summary: Yangzijiang Financial Holding Ltd. functions as an investment holding firm, undertaking various investment-related activities across both the People's Republic of China and Singapore. The company organizes its operations into three principal divisions: Investment Management, Fund Management, and Wealth Management. Its diverse financial offerings span debt and venture capital investments, microfinancing, comprehensive fund and wealth management services, and investment advisory. This Singapore-headquartered company was founded in 2021.
